summary: The base computes but discards the unrounded KV-only utilization ratio. The exact candidate exports it as sglang:kv_cache_usage_perc, preserves existing metrics, passes its regression suite and independent adversarial scheduler tests, and has internally consistent retained MI350X serving evidence.

tests.what_was_measured: At the recorded base, get_kv_token_stats returned 0.123456 but SchedulerStats lacked kv_cache_usage_perc; legacy token_usage was 0.12.
Candidate regression suite at exact commit: five plain, SWA, Mamba, combined hybrid, and precision cases passed.
Independent 0/1 boundaries, full-vs-SWA dominance, unrounded precision, Mamba exclusion, source import paths, and Prometheus serialization.
All 15 scheduler-component tests passed at the exact candidate commit.

tests.command: Independent inspection of candidate-retained tiny-Llama server request, response, metrics, metadata, and log
tests.what_was_measured: On MI350X/gfx950, POST /generate and GET /metrics returned 200; kv_cache_usage_perc and full_token_usage both measured 0.01171875 during active execution.

gpu_execution.evidence: Candidate-retained raw server evidence records AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 execution with a successful generation and metrics scrape. The reviewer inspected and retained it but did not rerun the server probe.

remaining_limitations: No end-to-end hybrid SWA or Mamba model was available; these semantics were independently exercised at the scheduler accounting boundary.
The tiny random Llama fixture does not validate semantic model accuracy or a different model architecture.
Only ROCm 7.2, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, and AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 evidence was available; CUDA and other architectures were not tested.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild and compiler/ISA validation were not applicable.
